required_source.actual_application: The physical-pair theorem closes the independent-input fixed matrix A=3B0; the new dependent-pair construction shows that this source-valid conclusion cannot be transferred through a joint pair-density cap alone.

partner_result.actual_application: On the crossed-star/tiny-tail family sigma=(1,1,eps), the partner no-leverage sigma3 endpoint gives <25/sqrt(|a|eps), while Delta2=1+2eps^2 remains constant but the ordinary range-leverage gate fails at the anchors.

premises: X is independent of the pair (Y,Z)
physical chain quadratic aX^2+2bXY+cY^2+2dYZ+affine with ad!=0

new_result.statement: ||p_Q||inf <= 4 sqrt(LK)/sqrt(|ad|); in the original independent cap-one case, <=4/sqrt(|ad|).
new_result.mechanism: condition on the middle original coordinate; convolve the one-sided square kernel against the affine transverse density; average the remaining reciprocal-square-root singularity against the actual capped middle marginal, never taking a fiber supremum

counterexample.matrix: A=3[[1,1,0],[1,0,1],[0,1,0]], all three eigenvalues have modulus >1
counterexample.construction: X uniform[0,1] independent of a dependent pair of unit joint density on E_N={e^-N/N<=y<=1/N, 0<=z<=1/(Ny)}; p_(Z|Y=y)<=1 but interval density lower bound sqrt(N)/36
counterexample.repair: retain a bounded middle marginal together with a bounded conditional transverse density, or stronger original-product provenance

first_unpaid_implication.statement: Every remaining no-pivot/high-leverage survivor not paid by existing volume/ridge/physical-pair exits yields a product-preserving chain with universally bounded LK and |ad| bounded below, or another already-paid exit.
